children: New Delhi, Sept. 9 -- Wheels India's share price has been on a strong uptrend recently, defying weak stock market sentiment. On Wednesday, 9 September, Wheels India shares surged 15% to hit a 52-week high of Rs.2,417.70 during the session.
The stock is up for the sixth consecutive session. In this period, Wheels India share price has surged 57%. On a monthly scale, the stock is up 51% so far in September after a 10% rise in August.
